summary: Focused testing of iteration_2 features: Lead Capture, Analytics tracking, QR + Poster, Accent Variants. Backend: 13/13 new pytest tests passed (leads create/404/400x2, admin list/patch/delete + 401, track view/scan/tap, analytics shape + counts increase, analytics 401, /qr PNG, /poster PNG attachment >5KB). Frontend: /feras-askar shows inquiry-form with all required inputs; submit produces inquiry-success + toast; share-bar/share-button/download-poster present. Admin: inbox-button opens leads-dialog with badge count, listing real leads; clicking lead marks read (updates badge), delete works. Analytics dialog opens via stats-feras-askar and shows stat-views/stat-scans/stat-taps/stat-leads with real numbers (views=7, scans=2, taps=3, leads=3 after UI flows). Editor: editor-accent (shadcn Select) switches Gold->Rose; live preview colors changed from rgb(184,153,115) to rgb(188,138,130) confirming accent recolors without layout change. Editor-template Select still switches (Beige Luxury -> Executive Black Gold). Save persists.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /cards/{slug}/leads only checks status=='published' - correct (unpublished => 404). Good.
POST /cards/{slug}/track does NOT verify the card exists; any slug will accept events. Consider validating slug to avoid orphan analytics rows (low priority).
POST /cards/{slug}/track returns {ok:false} with 200 for invalid type - consider 400 for stricter contract.
Analytics endpoint recomputes counts from full event scan each call (to_list 10000). Fine for demo scale; would want aggregation pipeline for larger data.
DELETE /admin/leads/{id} always returns ok even if id does not exist; consider 404 for idempotency-vs-visibility trade-off.
PUT /admin/cards/{id} overwrites accent/templateId as expected; make sure frontend always sends full CardUpsert (it does via CardEditor).
CORS allow_origins '*' with allow_credentials=True unchanged from iteration_1 - noted previously.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created transient TEST_-prefixed leads (self-cleaned within tests). One UI TEST_UI_Lead was created via inquiry-submit then deleted through the admin inbox UI test. Extra remaining TEST_Lead cleaned up post-run. feras-askar card was momentarily set to Executive Black Gold/Platinum during the accent+template save flow test then restored to beige-luxury/gold/published via PUT with DEMO_CARD payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covers leads, tracking, analytics, poster. LeadsDialog uses data-testid='lead-{id}' and 'lead-delete-{id}' (NOT 'lead-item-*'). AnalyticsDialog exposes stat-views/stat-scans/stat-taps/stat-leads. editor-accent and editor-template are shadcn Select comboboxes - click, wait, then click role=option. If restoring feras-askar demo, PUT full CardUpsert (frontend always does).
